cases.name: Each quality mode retains options and completes at its specified active duration
Report begins at commit; achieved task tier is exposed only on completion
Minimum fidelity cannot be exceeded by selecting a faster or higher quality mode
Intent mismatch is blocked before queue insertion and bestRoute never changes intent
Invalid fidelity enum values are rejected rather than defaulted silently
Selection is frozen at enqueue even if the caller mutates its options later
In-flight reports use the route snapshot instead of later registry mutations
Report snapshots deeply isolate metrics, evidence and warning arrays
Explicitly approved compatible route records its degradation configuration
Content-only report makes layout non-applicable and never emits measured document metrics
Cancelling or shutting down after commit removes provisional reports
Mixed-quality queue preserves per-task duration and paused time exclusion
Read-only protocol, generated registry, native binding and fifth page stay byte-identical
